heroHeadline: Day 952: IDF Kills Izz al-Din al-Haddad — Hamas Military Chief and 'Last Architect of October 7' in Gaza City Precision Strike; Former Hostages Describe 'Closure'
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 16, 2026 (Day 952): The IDF confirmed the killing of Izz al-Din al-Haddad, head of Hamas's military wing in Gaza and the last known senior architect of the October 7 attack still alive in Gaza. Three IAF jets dropped 13 bombs on a residential building in Gaza City's Rimal neighborhood Friday evening, also killing al-Haddad's wife, daughter, and four others. Al-Haddad was a founding Hamas member, a member of the Hamas Military Council, and the personal captor of five surveillance soldiers taken from the Nahal Oz intelligence post on October 7: Liri Albag, Daniela Gilboa, Karina Ariev, Naama Levy, and Agam Berger (all released alive in January 2025). IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir called it 'a significant operational achievement'; Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz: 'Sooner or later, Israel will reach you.' Former hostages described 'closure.' His elimination follows the deaths of Yahya Sinwar (Oct 16, 2024), Mohammed Sinwar, Iyad Shambari (Apr 29, 2026), and Ismail Haniyeh (Jul 31, 2024). Accountability front: With 46 days to the Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 investigation deadline, the Kallner inquiry bill — which dropped 'independent investigation' language and bars judges from commission membership — is advancing toward a first plenum reading in late May. A JPPI poll (May 15) showed 63% of Israelis support an immediate independent commission. Hamas's 1,195-death attack of October 7, 2023 — which triggered 251 hostage-takings (all accounted for as of January 26, 2026) and Operation Swords of Iron — remains the unresolved accountability wound at the heart of Israeli politics. Gaza ceasefire remains volatile: Israel controls 60%+ of Gaza, Hamas holds firm on disarmament refusal, IDF operational plans for resumed offensive complete pending US authorization.
